eligibility: Preregister comparable empirical/computational research eligibility. Decide how CS conference proceedings and Earth-science journal articles can be compared; do not silently mix reviews, benchmarks and research papers.

earth.note: Retain screen-negative papers in the sampling denominator. Scope of a Nature subset is only those selected journals; do not call it all geoscience.

source_frame.label: Candidate NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, ACL-family, CVPR or computing-journal frame

cs.note: Source/series identities, proceeding coverage, deduplication of preprint and publication, and article-type mapping require verification before retrieval. No guessed IDs supplied.

cautions: Earth measurement-family and CS information-channel multimodality are different constructs; do not equate their percentages without a separate shared definition and sensitivity analysis.
AI/DL/foundation-model use and pretraining are separately coded actual methods/results evidence, not keyword hits.
Author-reported barriers and assessor explanations are hypotheses to test, not causal explanations inferred from non-adoption.
